Fits the SII's weighted least squares regression model

fit_sii.Rd

A wrapper around lm() intended as a helper function for derive_deprivation_gap(). See that function for details on the scaled deprivation quintile and weighting. The SII is the gradient of line.

Usage

fit_sii(
  ed_data,
  ed_prop_col,
  sii_x_col = "sii_x",
  sii_weight_col = "sii_weight"
)

Arguments

ed_data

data.frame with columns specified by the following parameters:

ed_prop_col

String name of column in ed_data for the early diagnosis proportion.

sii_x_col

String name of the column in ed_data containing the scaled deprivation quintiles, by default denoted as sii_x.

sii_weight_col

String name of the column in ed_data containing the weights for the model.

Value

A linear model (lm) object where the Slope Index of Inequality is the coefficient of the sii_x variable.

Details

Fit a line of the form $$ y = \alpha + \beta x_i + \epsilon_i $$

Which minimises: $$\sum{weights * \epsilon^2}$$

Such that the SII is taken as \(\beta\). Or more fully given the expected inputs:

$$ \text{Early Diagnosis %} = \text{Intercept} + \text{SII} * \text{Scaled Deprivation} + \text{Error} $$
